text: Can you show how my kitchen could look renovated? Make one 16:9 before-and-after image, original on the left and your realistic makeover on the right. White shaker cabinets, light oak counters, white subway tiles, no clutter. Keep the same room layout and camera angle. Label them “Before” and “After”.

change.say: actually, change the “After” label to “New” and keep everything else the same.
